title: Design System: Caboodle Pipeline (dense ledger world)

display.purpose: The view title only; Space Grotesk is banned elsewhere in this world.

meta.purpose: Dates, counts, assignees; always tabular numerals.

shadows.name: modal-quiet
shadows.purpose: Pipeline modals; hairline border carries the edge, shadow stays tight.

shadows.name: today-inset
shadows.purpose: Today cell in the pipeline calendar.

motion.name: ease-quiet
motion.purpose: Hover fills and the single view-entrance moment; skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#4f46e5; color:#fff; border:1px solid #4f46e5; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 12px; font:500 12px Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6366f1; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:1; background:transparent; color:#9aa1af; border-color:#e5e7eb; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions and KPI pills; hairline border, flat active fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background:transparent; color:#51607a; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:6px 12px; font:500 12px Inter, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; cursor:pointer; transition:background .12s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#f4f5f8; color:#14161d; } .ds-btn-ghost-active { background:#eceef4; border-color:transparent; color:#14161d; font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview: This world treats the Pipeline view as a working ledger, not a showcase. Structure is carried entirely by hairlines, rhythm, and the property-dot system; depth, decoration, and tinted pills are refused. Everything on screen is information: state reads through colored text and small dots on neutral ground, counts use tabular numerals, and the single accent (indigo) is spent only on selection, focus, and the primary action.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed white panes split by a 1px hairline; no floating cards.
Contiguous dense rows; hover fills, no borders on rest.
Property dots: status, priority, and due urgency as colored text + small dots.
One accent rule: indigo on selection, focus rings, primary action only.
Keyboard-first: Enter adds, Space completes, Escape closes, / jumps to search.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears on <=3 surface types per screen: selection, focus, primary action. Everything else is ink on hairlines.

rules.name: The Dot-Not-Pill Rule
rules.body: State is colored text and a small dot on neutral ground; tinted pill backgrounds are refused for status, priority, and due dates.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is 1px #e9ebf0; no colored border-left above 1px on any row or card.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every count, date, and number column uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text below 0.7rem; dense means tight, not small.

dos: Do carry state with colored text + dots on neutral ground.
Do keep all numerals tabular in counts and dates.
Do reserve indigo for selection, focus, and the primary action.
Do give disabled controls visible ink (#9aa1af) at full opacity.
donts: Don't use tinted pill backgrounds for status, priority, or due dates.
Don't put colored borders (left/right >1px) on rows or cards.
Don't pair hairline borders with wide diffuse shadows; a defined edge or a tight shadow, never both.
Don't use Space Grotesk anywhere but the view title.
